intent: Block dated deletion events accumulate across months. Keep the scripted evidence boundary and lettering visible.
source:
**Frame:** The same deletion, repeated as a wall: a grid of deletion events over May and June, thousands of them, each a page name and a time, stacked until they fill the panel.

**Screen / system text:**
`5,217 SUCCESSFUL ADMINISTRATOR DELETIONS. 5,144 DISTINCT PAGES. ONE LABEL.`

**Caption:**
> THE MAINTAINER WAS NOT INVESTIGATING AN INCIDENT. THE MAINTAINER WAS CLEANING UP.

**Provenance:** `documented` + `inferred` — counts from `manifest.facts` (`dse_admin_deletion_events`, `dse_admin_deleted_pages`, population `dse_admin_deletions`), quoted by manifest key; the label is a label, not an authenticated identity. "Cleaning up" is the agents' own description of the sweep on [page 108](108.md), adopted as the project's reading, not the maintainer's stated purpose.
title: Dated deletion events accumulate across months
